description: This is a Python test script that performs load testing on Vertex AI embeddings, measuring response times to ensure performance benchmarks are met.

methods.name: load_vertex_ai_credentials()
methods.description: Loads and updates Google Cloud credentials for Vertex AI from environment variables and local JSON file.

methods.name: create_async_vertex_embedding_task()
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task to generate a vertex AI embedding and measures its execution time.

methods.name: run_load_test(duration_seconds, requests_per_second)
methods.description: Runs a load test for a specified duration and requests per second, gathering response times.

methods.name: analyze_results(vertex_times)
methods.description: Analyzes the recorded response times, computes the median, and asserts that it is within acceptable bounds.

methods.name: test_embedding_performance(monkeypatch)
methods.description: An asyncio pytest test that runs the load test and checks that median response time is below threshold.
